palette: deep turquoise field, linen parchment slips, coral clay, brass gold, sage green, violet slate, dark pine ink
typography: shield-hall headings on turquoise rail tabs, coral verdicts and brass condition plates
composition: a four-vitality rack, a name-portrait gallery with fair-use lanes and a photo rights triangle, and a reputation-privacy bench with concurrence rules and an enforcement strip
surface: linen parchment plaques on a deep turquoise field with brass corner studs
motion: vitality plaques light rank by rank, portrait tokens travel fair-use lanes, photo rights rotate their triangle, and concurrence chips merge or split at the bench
transition: the turquoise field, brass studs and parchment stock persist while racks, galleries and benches are re-dressed between scenes
